lines.trans: Hi, Dad, why did you come here?
I came to talk about the café that you chose for the wedding.
It is our wedding, we celebrate wherever we want!
Sweetheart, understand, a wedding is once in a lifetime.
Well, or at most twice in a lifetime.
I want the wedding to be in a luxurious restaurant!
So that you have an expensive and beautiful dress.
After all, all girls always want that!
I will be ashamed to invite my friends there.
Let's rent at least your restaurant, I will pay for everything!
Dad, we do not need your money at all!
If you are ashamed, you do not have to come to our wedding at all!
